messages.author: 28d95f30c3c9626d
messages.subject: Error in replicating a model
parts:
Hello!

I recently started learning Stan and I am working through a CFA model with categorical data from https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/stan-users/QDWOJNfPuLc to get a better feel on how the package works.

The only modification I made from the original model script is that I replaced <- to =  and I added a blank line at the end of the file to avoid the incomplete final line warning.

However, I ran into the following error:

> library(rstan)
> dat<-read.table("data1.dat", header=FALSE)
> N<-500
> K<-10
> F<-2
> cfa.data<-list(N=N,K=K,F=F,y=dat)
> Nchains<-2
> Niter<-10000
> model=rstan::stan_model(file='cfa2factor-chol2_modified.stan') 
> out=rstan::sampling(object = model
+                     , data=cfa.data
+                     , chains=Nchains
+                     , iter=Niter
+                     , warmup=Niter/2
+                     , refresh=Niter/10
+                     , seed=1)
Error in eval(substitute(expr), envir, enclos) : 
  variable does not exist; processing stage=data initialization; variable name=y; base type=int
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In is.na(x) : is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'
2: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : data with name y is not numeric and not used
failed to create the sampler; sampling not done
> 

Any suggestions or advice will be very much appreciated.

Thank you!

Chi

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error in replicating a model
parts:
You want to make sure your data is a list of variable names
and values with all the variables in your model defined and
no extraneous string variables.

- Bob
